---
title: "Retrospective forecasts 2025/26"
---

::: {.demo-banner}
Each forecast was recreated using only the information available on its forecast date. Select individual point forecasts and compare them with the probabilistic QRA ensemble.
:::

```{=html}
<div class="forecast-explorer" data-forecast-mode="retrospective">
<div class="forecast-controls" aria-label="Retrospective forecast selections">
<div class="forecast-control">
<label for="forecast-location">Location</label>
<select id="forecast-location" class="form-select" disabled></select>
</div>
<div class="forecast-control">
<label for="forecast-reference-date">Forecast date</label>
<select id="forecast-reference-date" class="form-select" disabled></select>
</div>
</div>
<div class="forecast-model-controls" aria-label="Select models">
<div class="forecast-model-heading">
<strong>Forecasts shown</strong>
<span>
<button id="forecast-select-all" type="button" class="btn btn-sm btn-outline-secondary">Select all</button>
<button id="forecast-clear-all" type="button" class="btn btn-sm btn-outline-secondary">Clear point models</button>
</span>
</div>
<label class="forecast-ensemble-option"><input id="forecast-qra" type="checkbox" checked> <span class="forecast-model-swatch ensemble"></span>QRA ensemble with 50%, 80% and 95% prediction intervals</label>
<div id="forecast-model-checkboxes" class="forecast-model-checkboxes"></div>
</div>
<div id="forecast-status" class="small-note" role="status">Loading forecasts …</div>
<div class="forecast-date-navigation" aria-label="Change forecast date">
<button id="forecast-date-earlier" type="button" class="btn btn-outline-secondary">← Earlier</button>
<span id="forecast-date-position" aria-live="polite"></span>
<button id="forecast-date-later" type="button" class="btn btn-outline-secondary">Later →</button>
</div>
<div id="forecast-chart" aria-label="Retrospective point forecasts and probabilistic ensemble"></div>
</div>
```

The black line shows the frozen observed values. The point-model lines show horizons 0–3 from the selected forecast date. The QRA median is shown as a dark-blue line, with uncertainty represented by three shaded intervals.
